description: 30 days of hourly cross-exchange spreads (MEXC/Binance/Bybit/OKX) ($0.015 USDC). Every venue publishes its own prices; nobody archives the spread between them.

payment.description: Optional. Base64 x402 payment payload you signed yourself (ERC-3009 TransferWithAuthorization, USDC on Base). Call without it once to receive the payment requirements, sign those, then call again with this argument. This server forwards the payload and never holds a key.

name: get_arbitrage_spread_history
